findings: Lateral radiograph of the ankle and foot shows an area of cortical irregularity at the distal aspect of the fibula, which may represent a non-displaced fracture. The distal tibia and joint spaces appear grossly intact.
impression: Possible non-displaced distal fibular fracture. Correlation with additional views (AP/Mortise) is recommended.
limitations: The assessment is limited to a single lateral projection. Subtle fractures or those in different planes may not be fully characterized. The bone-fracture-detection model output is used as supporting evidence only and is not a definitive clinical diagnosis.
